name: Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple
timings: 3:00 AM – 11:00 PM; Mangala Aarti 3–4 AM, Bhog 11:15 AM, Saptarishi 7 PM, Shringar 9 PM, Shayan 10:30 PM
closures: Open all year; general darshan pauses during each aarti. Sparsh (touch) darshan is often suspended in Shravan, Mahashivratri and peak crowds
entry: Free. Sugam Darshan ₹250 (6 AM–6 PM, per official schedule; older FAQ says ₹300). Mangala Aarti ₹500; other aartis ₹300; Shayan Aarti free

booking.name: Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple Trust – official portal / app

dress_code: No strict code for darshan, decent clothes advised; Sparsh darshan: unstitched dhoti for men, saree for women
rules: Mobile phones, cameras, smartwatches and all electronic gadgets not allowed
Pens, bags, belts and leather purses not allowed
Lockers/baggage counters may be closed on peak days (e.g. Mahashivratri) – leave items at hotel
Mangala Aarti: report by 2:30 AM, enter via Gate No. 1
Aarti bookings are non-refundable and dates cannot be changed

festivals.name: Rangbhari Ekadashi
festivals.when: Phalgun Shukla Ekadashi, ~12 days after Shivaratri

airport.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport, Babatpur

reach.road: Varanasi is linked by NH to Prayagraj, Lucknow and Patna; Chaudhary Charan Singh Bus Stand is the main bus station (km approx.)
reach.local: Cars stop short of the old city; e-rickshaw/auto to Godowlia then walk, or approach from Lalita Ghat via the Kashi Vishwanath Dham corridor

avg_visit_time: 1–3 hours (much longer on Mondays, Shravan and festivals)
tips: Leave phone, bag, belt and pen at your hotel – security is strict
Book Mangala Aarti well in advance on the official site; tickets cannot be cancelled
Sugam Darshan includes a guide (Shastri), prasad box and locker
Avoid Mondays and Shravan if you want short queues
Free Shayan Aarti at 10:30 PM is a good no-ticket option
notes: Sugam Darshan fee differs between official pages (₹250 on daily schedule vs ₹300 in FAQ PDF). Airport/station km are approximate road distances.

name: Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple)
timings: Complex open 24 hrs; Prakash (Palki Sahib to sanctum) ~4–5 AM, Sukhasan ~9:45–10:45 PM – exact times shift by season (SGPC)
entry: Free; Guru Ka Langar (free meals) served to all

booking.name: No darshan booking required (SGPC official site for info / sarai)

dress_code: Head must be covered (free scarves at entrances); modest clothing, avoid short or showy clothes; shoes and socks removed
rules: Cover your head and remove shoes and socks; wash hands and feet before entering
Tobacco, cigarettes, alcohol and intoxicants strictly prohibited – not even in pockets or bags
Photography/videography without permission prohibited; keep phones silent
Sit cross-legged on the parikrama; no feeding fish or throwing items in the sarovar
Open to people of all faiths; follow sewadar instructions

airport.name: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport

reach.road: Amritsar bus stand is ~1.7 km away; well connected by NH to Jalandhar, Delhi and Jammu
reach.local: Auto/e-rickshaw to Heritage Street, then walk through the pedestrian plaza to the main entrance

tips: Visit around the early-morning Palki Sahib procession – atmospheric and less crowded
Free shoe deposit and head-scarves are at every main entrance
Eat at Guru Ka Langar and consider volunteering (seva) in the kitchen
Expect long sanctum queues on weekends and Gurpurabs; night visits are quieter
Check sgpc.net daily routine for the current season's Prakash/Sukhasan times
notes: Exact Prakash/Sukhasan clock times change through the year; values here are ranges. Guru Ram Das Prakash Purab 2026 date not verified. Elevation is approximate (Amritsar city).

name: Sri Venkateswara Temple
timings: Suprabhatam ~2:30–3 AM; darshan roughly 7/9:30 AM – 7 PM and 8 PM – ~1 AM (varies by weekday); Ekanta Seva ~12:45–1:30 AM
closures: Open all year; schedules change on festivals, and privileged/VIP darshans are cancelled during Brahmotsavams
entry: Sarva Darshan free (SSD tokens); Special Entry Darshan ₹300 (online, time-slotted); arjitha sevas priced separately

booking.name: TTD Online Services (official) / TTD mobile app

dress_code: Traditional dress for ₹300 darshan, sevas & VIP: men dhoti or kurta-pyjama; women saree/half-saree or churidar with dupatta
rules: Mobile phones, cameras and electronic gadgets not allowed inside – deposit at counters near VQC
Enter queue only at your allotted SSD/₹300 time slot (strictly enforced since Mar 2026)
Non-Hindus must sign a faith declaration (free) at VQC or TTD offices before darshan
Book only via the official TTD site/app; beware of touts selling tickets
Ghat roads normally closed to vehicles 12 AM – 3 AM

reach.road: Up ghat road Tirupati–Tirumala 17.8 km; APSRTC buses from Tirupati roughly every few minutes
reach.local: Free TTD buses around Tirumala; walk from your VQC/queue entry to the temple

trek.notes: TTD pages variously give Alipiri as ~11 km or 7.8 km (~3 hrs) and Srivari Mettu as ~6 km or 2.1 km (~1.5 hrs). Free luggage transfer; Divya Darshan tokens for walkers

avg_visit_time: Half day to a full day (free Sarva Darshan queues can take many hours on peak days)
tips: Book ₹300 Special Entry Darshan online early – quotas release on fixed dates
Arrive exactly at your slot; early or late arrivals are turned away
Leave phones at the free deposit counter and keep the receipt
Walkers: deposit luggage at Alipiri for free transport to Tirumala
Collect laddu prasadam at the counter after darshan
notes: Footpath lengths conflict across TTD's own pages. Daily schedule varies by weekday (official day-schedule shows 9:30 AM–7 PM & 8 PM–12:30 AM for 21 Oct 2026). Vaikunta Ekadasi 2026/27 date not verified from TTD. Airport km approximate.

name: Meenakshi Amman Temple (Arulmigu Meenakshi Sundareswarar)
timings: 5:00 AM – 12:30 PM, 4:00 PM – 10:00 PM; Thiruvanandal Pooja 5:30 AM, Palliyarai Pooja 9:30 PM
closures: Open all year; closed 12:30–4:00 PM daily; timings change on festival days
entry: Free. Special entrance ₹50 (Amman or Swamy) / ₹100 (both); foreigners entry ₹50 (per 2024 HC record)

booking.name: Tamil Nadu HR&CE – official temple portal

dress_code: Traditional/modest: men dhoti or trousers with shirt; women saree, half-saree or churidar with dupatta; avoid shorts/sleeveless
rules: Camera phones banned inside; deposit at entrance counters (₹5, receipt issued)
Footwear left outside; cloak room ₹2
Non-Hindus not allowed beyond the kodimaram (flagstaff) / sanctums (Madras HC, Jan 2024)
Paid online tickets are non-cancellable; a government ID is needed per person

reach.road: Periyar bus stand is ~1 km away; Madurai is well connected by NH to Chennai, Trichy and Kanyakumari
reach.local: Walk or take an auto to the Chithirai streets around the temple; main entry via the four towers (gopurams)

tips: Go before 8 AM or soon after 4 PM reopening for shorter queues
Leave your phone at the hotel or the ₹5 deposit counter
Plan around the 12:30–4 PM closure
Don't miss the Thousand Pillar Hall (Aayiram Kaal Mandapam) museum
Maha Kumbabishekam held 17 Sep 2026 – expect updated arrangements afterwards
notes: Tamil Nadu Tourism lists older hours (6 AM–12:30 PM, 4–9 PM); official HR&CE hours used. Phone ban reported by Dinamalar from 1 Sep (2026). Foreigner fee is from a 2024 court record and may have changed.

name: Shree Jagannath Temple
timings: ~5:30 AM – ~9:00 PM; Mangala Aarti early morning; no darshan ~8–9:15 AM (Gopal Ballava Puja); ritual times vary daily
closures: No darshan for ~15 days (Anavasara) after Snana Purnima in Jun–Jul; deities leave the temple during Rath Yatra
entry: Free; no official paid darshan verified

booking.name: No darshan booking; SJTA official site (accommodation & donations)

dress_code: Decent attire (since 1 Jan 2024): no shorts or torn jeans for men; no skirts, jeans or sleeveless for women
rules: Only Hindus are allowed inside the temple
Mobile phones, cameras, electronic gadgets, footwear and leather items not allowed (free stands at Lion's Gate)
No caps, umbrellas, plastic bags, tobacco or cooked food
Lion's Gate (east) is the only entry; other gates are exits
Observe silence; beware of pickpockets and monkeys
best_time: October – March (Rath Yatra in Jun–Jul for the festival)

reach.road: Regular buses and taxis from Bhubaneswar (~60 km) and Cuttack (~82 km)
reach.local: Auto/e-rickshaw to Bada Danda (Grand Road); free battery vehicles for seniors/disabled from Jagannath Ballav parking

tips: Use the free shoe/mobile stands near Lion's Gate before joining the queue
Buy Mahaprasad at Ananda Bazaar inside the temple (north-east corner)
Avoid the Anavasara fortnight if darshan is your goal
Book stay months ahead for Rath Yatra; SJTA runs guest houses
Check 'Today in the Temple' on the official site for live ritual times
notes: Timings are approximate per SJTA; actual niti times vary daily. Odisha Tourism lists Akshaya Tritiya as 20 Apr 2026 but Chandan Yatra start as 19 Apr 2026 – used as published.
